title: Finding envelope (per-specialist multi-agent review output)
description: Output schema for one of the four reviewer specialist personas (reviewer-{security,architecture,correctness,style}). Validates ONE specialist's structured output before aggregation. Aggregator-side decoration fields (seen_by[], was_in_prior, summary tier) are out of scope; the aggregate envelope has its own (looser) shape per scripts/spawn-multi-reviewer.sh. Per spec 72c §5 + §9 carry-over.

blocking.description: Whether this finding gates the merge button (true) or is advisory (false)

category.description: Free-form sub-category. Personas use their dimension as default ('security' | 'architecture' | 'correctness' | 'style') but emit finer-grained sub-categories (e.g. 'edge-case', 'commenting') for granular dedup.

evidence.description: Quote from diff or AC, ≤2 lines. First 64 chars are part of the aggregator's dedup key per spec 72c §5 rule 2.
